mapper.select:
SELECT tal.tal_id AS candidateId, IFNULL(u.nick_name, u.user_name) AS userName, u.phonenumber AS phonenumber, (SELECT pos.pos_title FROM t_process_instance pin INNER JOIN t_pos pos ON pos.pos_id = pin.pin_position_id WHERE pin.pin_id = tal.tal_process_instance_id LIMIT 1) AS jobName, tal.tal_matched_score AS totalScore, CASE tal.tal_status WHEN 0 THEN 'new' WHEN 1 THEN 'screened' WHEN 2 THEN 'interviewing' WHEN 3 THEN 'rejected' WHEN 4 THEN 'passed' WHEN 5 THEN 'passed' WHEN 6 THEN 'archived' WHEN 7 THEN 'archived' WHEN 8 THEN 'rejected' WHEN 9 THEN 'new' ELSE 'new' END AS status, tal.tal_status AS statusCode, tal.tal_updated_at AS updateTime, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(tg.tg_name SEPARATOR ',') FROM t_tal_tag tg WHERE tg.tg_candidate_id = tal.tal_id) AS tags FROM t_tal tal INNER JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = tal.tal_user_id
AND (IFNULL(u.nick_name, u.user_name) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{userName}, '%') OR u.phonenumber LIKE CONCAT('%', #{userName}, '%'))
AND ( CASE tal.tal_status WHEN 0 THEN 'new' WHEN 1 THEN 'screened' WHEN 2 THEN 'interviewing' WHEN 3 THEN 'rejected' WHEN 4 THEN 'passed' WHEN 5 THEN 'passed' WHEN 6 THEN 'archived' WHEN 7 THEN 'archived' WHEN 8 THEN 'rejected' WHEN 9 THEN 'new' ELSE 'new' END = #{status} )
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM t_tal_tag tg WHERE tg.tg_candidate_id = tal.tal_id AND tg.tg_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{tags}, '%') )
ORDER BY tal.tal_updated_at DESC, tal.tal_id DESC

SELECT tal.tal_id AS candidateId, IFNULL(u.nick_name, u.user_name) AS userName, u.phonenumber AS phonenumber, u.email AS email, (SELECT pos.pos_title FROM t_process_instance pin INNER JOIN t_pos pos ON pos.pos_id = pin.pin_position_id WHERE pin.pin_id = tal.tal_process_instance_id LIMIT 1) AS jobName, tal.tal_matched_score AS totalScore, tal.tal_status AS statusCode, tal.tal_company_id AS companyId, tal.tal_resume_id AS resumeId, tal.tal_created_at AS createTime, tal.tal_updated_at AS updateTime FROM t_tal tal INNER JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = tal.tal_user_id WHERE tal.tal_id = #{talId}
SELECT tg_name FROM t_tal_tag WHERE tg_candidate_id = #{talId} ORDER BY tg_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_tal_tag (tg_candidate_id, tg_name, tg_source, tg_created_at, tg_updated_at) VALUES (#{talId}, #{name}, 1, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE t_tal SET tal_status = #{status}, tal_updated_at = NOW() WHERE tal_id = #{talId}
